## IFileAdditionPresentationContext interface

A proposal to add a new file, shown in the review body with the findings that carry it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface IFileAdditionPresentationContext extends IPresentationContext 
```
**Extends:** [IPresentationContext](./sarif-to-comment.ipresentationcontext.md)

## Remarks

`required` holds the path as a code span, the file details, the content block (when the file has content) and the findings: together they state the destination and the file's exact bytes.
